name: Use constructor injection and correct service lifetimes
statement: Register dependencies in the composition root, inject them explicitly through constructors, and choose singleton, scoped, or transient lifetime according to ownership and concurrency behavior.
rationale: Explicit dependency graphs keep orchestration testable and prevent hidden service location, accidental per-request state sharing, and undisposed resources.

badExample.description: Business code reaches into the service provider

history.change: Initial DI rule based on Quality Studio's ASP.NET composition root and injectable core services.
